minutes_text:
SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Wednesday, April 19th, 2023
_________________________________________________________________
1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order at
  10:04 AM on Wednesday, April 19th, 2023.

  Members present: Terry Kistler, George Borst, Scott Snider, Lorraine Missick, Jenny
  Jolly, Edward Padgett, Bette Donovan and Rafaela Giles.

  Members Absent: None

  Staff Present: Yvonne Duran, Community Services Director and Amanda Triay,
  Community Services Specialist.

  Guest Present: None.

  It was moved and seconded to approve the minutes of the Wednesday, March 15th,
  2023, meeting. Motion carried.

2. Guest Speaker: JR Ranells, Assistant City Manager.

  Unfinished Business

3. Senior Nutrition Program:

  Grab-n-Go Meals: Meals were distributed to an average of 162 participants per week
  in March.

  Congregate Meals: Meals were served to an average of 39 participants per week in
  March.

  Meals on Wheels: 687 meals served to 42 La Verne recipients in February; 810
  meals served to 41 La Verne recipients in March.

4. Bingo Report: The total balance in the account for the month of March was
  $2,066.41. The average attendance for March was 65 players per week.

5. Account Balance: $8,252.30.

6. Senior Program Fees: All fees have been paid.
 7. MT. SAC Classes: Classes going well. Registration will be June 2nd.

8. Aging Next: March total number of La Verne residents served was 8 (via Joslyn
  Center and Aging Next office).

  New Business

9. Facilities Report: Meeting with a roofer for the leak in the back area of the
  Community Center. Veterans Hall roof is fixed and bathrooms are fixed for leaks.

10. Outstanding Older American: Outstanding Older American Recognition honored at
  the May 1st City Council Meeting.

11. Upcoming Events:
  - Sunday, April 23rd – Community Event: Heart of the Foothills, 9:00 AM-
  4:00 PM
  - Friday, April 28th – Excursion: The Grove/Farmer’s Market & Griffith
  Observatory, 1:00-10:00 PM
  - Sunday, April 30th – Under the Sea Dinner Dance Extravaganza, 4:00-
  7:00PM
  - Wednesday, May 3rd – Excursion: Descanso Gardens, 9:30 AM-4:30 PM
  - Wednesday, May 3rd – Senior Seminar: Health and Exercise – Optum,
  9:30 AM
  - Monday, May 8th – Movie Matinee, 12:30 PM
  - Saturday, May 13th – Excursion: A Day at Catalina Island, 7:30 AM-6:30
  PM

12. Public Comments: Hillcrest Dining Room is now open to the public.

13. Adjourn: It was moved and seconded to adjourn the meeting at 11:08 AM. Motion
  carried. The next meeting will be on Wednesday, May 17th  `  q  at
  10:00 AM.
